original_visible_content.stem:
A community pharmacist evaluates controlled-drug requests. The facts distinguish patient-specific prescriptions from stock orders and maintenance treatment from other indications. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which proposed actions are supported by the applicable requirements? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: A pharmacy documents a stock-bottle distribution only as a patient prescription refill transfer.
A pharmacist assesses a clinically significant sedative combination and records the intervention.
A pharmacist searches a neighbor’s controlled-drug history out of personal curiosity.
A pharmacist recognizes a state supply allowance as an upper limit, not permission to dispense more than the prescribed quantity.
A pharmacist uses the general Schedule III refill rules to bypass the depot product’s provider-delivery restriction.
